title: The WP Fastest Cache – WordPress Cache Plugin plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to arbitrary directory deletion due…
description: The WP Fastest Cache WordPress plugin up to version 1.5.4 contains a vulnerability in the singleDeleteCache function that allows unauthenticated attackers to delete arbitrary files on the server due to insufficient file path validation. Exploitation requires the presence of either the Custom Permalinks or GeoDirectory plugin, which enable insertion of traversal payloads into the database that WP Fastest Cache uses without validation. This can lead to remote code execution if critical files like wp-config.php are deleted.
